# IPD Agent Workflow Framework v0.5.5-beta

Independent supporting work and one coherent requirements/work Dashboard. See the bilingual [work-product guide](https://github.com/zju-CS-yzy/ipd-agent-workflow-skill/blob/v0.5.5-beta/docs/work-products.md).

- Professional supporting work can be a real Deliverable with its own Claim, review and acceptance. Attachments and references retain one Owner and separate file availability.
- Zero-write `work-plan` produces extension, binding and stage-unit candidates and detects stale inputs, conflicts and missing explicit prerequisites. Existing tailoring and baseline controls accept the candidates.
- One entity projection drives the single requirement/work matrix and both graphs. Core Deliverables without requirement links remain visible; shared work retains reverse consumers and exact increment/history context.
- The stage SVG graph appears immediately below the dependency graph and shares card, edge, zoom, selection and detail behavior. Requirement ancestry, support and output relationships remain distinct from execution dependencies.
- Renderer fingerprints and canonical projection checks protect Dashboard freshness. The release waits for its exact Tag CI in a separate bounded qualification job before building and publishing assets.

### Compatibility

Redrawing old projects changes only derived views. New persistent roles require explicit registry 1.2 / contract 0.5.5 adoption before work is accepted in the increment; the prior registry snapshot is hashed and retained. Older clients reject writes to the new contract. Stable IDs, historical Owners, approvals and template pack 1.3.0 remain intact.

### Approval boundary

One active increment, Claim and Review subject remain enforced. Material availability does not borrow Owner acceptance. A stage conclusion does not replace independent professional review. No role, support edge, generated graph or completed template grants human approval. Existing local authorization declarations are not authenticated platform identities.

### Known limitations

Markdown remains the supported document format. Native DOCX/XLSX, automatic historical Owner/path migration, authenticated approval adapters and concurrent governance remain outside this version. No private Golden project was available; public synthetic qualification does not establish real-project acceptance. Windows source builds may need a short path where legacy path limits apply. Publication/download qualification is recorded after the immutable Tag passes its own CI.

### 兼容性

旧项目重画只更新派生视图。新增材料角色需显式采纳 Schema 1.2 / 契约 0.5.5，并保留带哈希的旧登记快照；旧客户端拒绝写入新契约。已有编号、Owner、审批历史及模板包 1.3.0 保留。已接受成果的增量应保持原事实，在新增量安全边界采纳。

专业支撑工作成为真实流程交付件；附件/参考资料分别显示可用性，不复制 Owner 审批。统一矩阵覆盖需求、交付件、文档与材料；阶段 SVG 图紧接依赖图，并使用共同的节点样式、详情和联动。`work-plan` 只预览候选，应用继续经过既有裁剪、绑定和基线治理。

### 审批边界

保持单增量、单 Claim 和单评审对象。阶段结论不代替专业交付件评审；结构就绪、文件存在、支撑边或模板填完均不等于人工批准。授权声明不追认为平台认证身份。

### 已知限制

本版不含 DOCX/XLSX、历史自动迁移、可信身份映射及并发治理。无私有 Golden 可用，公开合成测试不能代替真实项目验收。存在旧式路径长度限制的 Windows 环境可用 wheel 或短源码目录。
